title: Evaluation of Persistence of Anti-meningococcal Bactericidal Antibodies Among Adolescents Who Previously Received MenACWY Conjugate Vaccine
brief_summary: The primary objective is to evaluate the persistence of bactericidal antibodies in adolescents previously enrolled in the V59P13 study who received either Novartis MenACWY Conjugate Vaccine or commercially available MenACWY conjugate vaccine. The study will also enroll age-matched subjects who have never received any other meningococcal vaccine (naïve subjects) to serve as an additional control group.
